# ADR-3060: A05: Documented non-prod parity exception for lab 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Some labs need looser settings.

## Decision

Labs MAY adopt a documented non-prod parity exception for lab 12 (A05-12) when full prod hardening blocks testing.

## Consequences

Exceptions is expected to apply to production accounts.
